# r-pkg-kit

> Start an R package with tests, CI and GitHub set up, or add ready-made CI and a quality gate to an existing package.

## Guides

- [How do I run R CMD check on GitHub Actions the way CRAN does?](https://r-pkg-kit.example.com/guides/r-cmd-check-on-github-actions): one short workflow file, and why devtools::check() isn't enough.

## Tools

- [Start a package](https://r-pkg-kit.example.com/start): a form that builds a package zip in your browser.
